description: This is a PHP source file defining an API endpoint class for managing Job Titles within an HR management system. The class includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting job titles, leveraging OpenAPI annotations for documentation and a service layer for business logic. It employs validation rules and handles various request parameters related to job title data, including specifications and associations.

classes.name: JobTitleAPI
classes.description: Endpoint class for managing Job Titles, supporting CRUD operations with validation, request parameter handling, and integrated documentation via OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the JobTitleService instance used for business logic operations related to Job Titles.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Job Title by ID, returning a formatted model or throwing a not found exception.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of all job titles with optional filtering for active status and supports sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Job Title based on submitted data, including optional job specification attachment.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the properties of a JobTitle entity from request parameters.

methods.name: setJobSpecification
methods.description: Assigns a Base64 encoded attachment as a job specification to a JobTitle.

methods.name: getBase64JobSpecification
methods.description: Retrieves the Base64 attachment from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, primarily checking for a valid ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Defines the validation rules for listing job titles, including active status filter and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a JobTitle, validation, and attachment processing.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Populates a JobTitle entity with parameters from the request body.

methods.name: setJobSpecification
methods.description: Associates a Base64 attachment with a JobSpecificationAttachment entity.

methods.name: getBase64JobSpecification
methods.description: Extracts Base64 attachment data from request for processing.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a Job Title, including unique name validation.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for common body parameters including title, description, and note.

methods.name: getJobTitleCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns options for unique validation of job title name, ignoring deleted entries.

methods.name: getSpecificationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for job specification attachment.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing Job Title, including managing attached specifications based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating a Job Title, including ID validation and specification handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple Job Titles by IDs, returning the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation based on ID list.
